explanation: The Komlós conjecture: a universal K such that any vectors of Euclidean norm ≤ 1 admit signs with ‖Σεᵢvᵢ‖_∞ ≤ K. The encoding is correct. It is tagged solved, citing Guo–Fang–Lu and Karingula–Lovett, with a linked formal proof. That is a recent resolution I did not independently verify (Bansal–Jiang 2025 had (log n)^{1/4}). The statement is faithful.
